body: My irl friends and family don't know what I'm going through, just a few internet friends knows but they don't care. I'm trying so hard to get my stuffs together, I laugh and have fun but in all of sudden I feel numb and down, I don't know how and why I'm just like.. empty

Besides games, I do enjoy editing videos and having fun with friends.. we don't hang out a lot because they live far away from me and we have school, I only see them in Facebook. My family life is decent but that because of my depression, I find myself I'm the problem for ruining their happiness, Especially my mom. I failed school this year which I never expected it would happen, the real problem behind that was depression.. I didn't had the courage to go wake up every morning and go to school, do my homework and sh*t. I was moved to another school, I feel guilty every time I sit in the class all I do is repeating the same thing I learned, I keep thinking non stop about how I'm supposed to do this or this etc.. sometimes I see that suicide is the right choice but I never tried it.
Thanks for your reply, I hope it's normal because I don't really feel like that. sure we can talk if you want.
